notes: Percent conventions: where the game treats a stat as a multiplier on a 100% base (Luck, Greed, Might), values are stored as fractional deltas (e.g. +10% -> 0.10) in *Bonus fields, and as explicit multipliers only where a source states a multiplier (e.g. maxHealth PowerUp multiplierPerRank 1.1). All times in seconds. RESEARCH CONSTRAINT: the network egress proxy blocked WebFetch/curl to vampire.survivors.wiki, vampire-survivors.fandom.com, steamcommunity.com and all other hosts; all data below was obtained via WebSearch result summaries of those exact pages. Numbers not surfaced by search are null, not guessed.

conflicts.note: One source gives per-chest-level gold bands; the other gives a single 60-500 range for any chest. The per-level bands are the more recent/likely-current figures but this was not verifiable without direct page access.

7,818,959 (base 1,911,240 + fees 5,907,719) vs 27,148,513 (base 2,469,640 + fees 24,678,873). Almost certainly different game versions / different PowerUp counts. Use the official-wiki figure for a current base-game reference.
27 is stated to include the separate Seal PowerUps.

floorPickups.notes: All of these drop from destroyed light sources unless stated otherwise. 'Rarity' on the wiki is the relative weight of the item in the light-source loot pool; Luck multiplies that weight for everything except Gold Coin and Coin Bag. Exact weight values were not retrievable.

items.name: Gold Coin
items.effect: Increases Gold Coin total by 1, multiplied by the Greed stat.
items.note: Most common light-source drop. Luck does NOT increase its chance (Luck raises the weight of everything else).

items.name: Coin Bag
items.effect: Increases Gold Coin total by 10, multiplied by the Greed stat.

items.name: Rich Coin Bag
items.effect: Increases Gold Coin total by 100, multiplied by the Greed stat.

items.name: Big Coin Bag
items.effect: Increases Gold Coin total by 25, multiplied by the Greed stat.
items.note: Not a floor pickup. Offered as one of the two level-up options once all owned weapons and passives are maxed (with Limit Break disabled).

items.name: Rosary
items.effect: Instantly kills all enemies on screen.

items.name: Orologion
items.effect: Creates a spinning blue ring around the player and freezes all enemies for 10 seconds.
items.note: Arcana XII (Out of Bounds) makes Orologions easier to find.

items.name: Vacuum
items.effect: Pulls all Experience Gems lying on the ground toward the character and collects them.

items.name: Nduja Fritta Tanto
items.effect: The character breathes fire in the direction they are facing for 10 seconds.

items.name: Little Clover
items.effect: Increases Luck by 10% until the end of the stage.
items.note: Described as the second-rarest light-source drop.

lightSources.description: Destructible props (braziers/lamps) that spawn randomly on the stage and drop exactly one pickup when destroyed.

luckRules.mechanism: Luck multiplies the weight ('rarity') of every pickup in the light-source pool EXCEPT Gold Coin and Coin Bag, so it shifts the distribution toward rare drops.
luckRules.spawnCapCaveat: While the maximum number of light sources is already on the map, spawn attempts are no longer influenced by Luck, so they spawn less often.

lightSources.stageNotes: Most DLC stages, and Capella Magna, have a higher maximum light-source count than standard base-game stages. Exact per-stage numbers not retrieved.

treasureChests.rollOrder: The game checks each treasure level starting from level 3 (5 items), falling through to level 2 (3 items), then level 1 (1 item). If all checks fail, the chest's base level is used.

variables.levelChance: the per-level probability configured on the specific boss/enemy that dropped the chest
variables.totalLuck: displayed Luck percentage + 100, expressed as a multiplier (e.g. +30% Luck -> 1.30)

luckFormula.note: Per-level base chances are configured individually per boss enemy, so there is no single global table.

exampleBaseOdds.enemy: Silver Bat (first one in Mad Forest at 9:00)
exampleBaseOdds.note: Rolled in that order; each roll is multiplied by totalLuck.

treasureChests.rollTiming: Chest contents/level are determined when the chest is OPENED, not when it drops. Leaving chests on the ground until Luck is higher works.

evolutionRules.note: When evolution/union requirements are met and the run is at 10:00 or later, chests can evolve or unite a weapon. Generally only one weapon evolves per chest, including higher-tier chests, though some chests contain multiple evolutions.

treasureChests.fallbackReward: If nothing in the player's inventory can be upgraded, chests award extra coins instead.

inRunSources: Gold Coin pickups from light sources (1 gold x Greed)
Coin Bag from light sources (10 gold x Greed)
Rich Coin Bag from light sources after level 5 (100 gold x Greed)
Big Coin Bag from the level-up menu when everything is maxed (25 gold x Greed)
Extra coins from chests / level-ups when nothing can be upgraded

greed.displayConvention: The stat panel shows the DIFFERENCE from base Greed; +30% displayed means 130% total Greed (multiplier 1.30).
greed.stacking: Character bonuses, PowerUps and items stack ADDITIVELY into the Greed total. Stage-level gold bonuses stack MULTIPLICATIVELY with that collective total.

maxKnownCombo.note: The Bone Zone in Hyper mode doubles overall gold gain; combined with +100% Greed this gives 4x base gold.

endOfRunPayout.note: Stated as an additional reward on death/run end after completing the stage, +100 per revival left unused. Gold gathered in-run persists to the account whether the run ends in death or completion. Whether the 500 applies to all base-game stages or only to stage completion specifically was not verifiable.

powerUpShop.powerUpCountNote: 27 per the official wiki (including the separate Seal PowerUps); Fandom states 24. See conflicts.

variables.bought: ranks of THIS PowerUp already bought
variables.totalBought: ranks of ALL PowerUps already bought (drives the global fee)

costFormula.baseCostRule: Each rank bought raises the base cost of the next rank of the same PowerUp by initialPrice. E.g. initialPrice 200 -> 5 ranks cost 200+400+600+800+1000 = 3000 in base cost, before fees.
costFormula.feeRule: The fee term floor(20 * 1.1^totalBought) is a GLOBAL fee driven by the total number of ranks bought across all PowerUps. No fee is applied while totalBought == 0. Since v0.7.2 (9 June 2022) fees are additive, so purchase order no longer affects the total.

powerUpShop.perRankCostTableNote: Cannot be produced without every PowerUp's initialPrice and maxRank plus a fixed purchase order for the global fee term. The formula above reproduces it exactly once those inputs are known.
powerUpShop.disableRule: After maxing a PowerUp the player may disable it, except for Rerolls, Skips, Banishes and Seals.

powerUps.name: Greed
powerUps.note: Greed PowerUps total +50% at max per the gold-farming guide; per-rank split not retrieved.

powerUps.name: Seal
powerUps.note: Counted as several separate Seal PowerUps in the wiki's 27 total. Cannot be disabled after maxing.

overview.unlockSystem: Collecting the Randomazzo relic in Gallo Tower unlocks the Arcana system and the first Arcana, Sarabande of Healing (VI). The remaining base-set Arcanas are unlocked either by reaching level 50 with certain characters, or by surviving to the 31:00 mark on certain stages.
overview.selection: Arcanas can be toggled on/off from the stage-select screen. With Arcanas enabled, the player normally obtains up to three per run: one is chosen from any unlocked Arcana at the start of the run, and the others are offered at set points during the run. Certain effects allow obtaining more than three.
overview.extraSet: Collecting the Darkasso in Room 1665 unlocks a further 'Darkana' set, unlocked by tasks with other characters.
overview.theme: Loosely based on the real-world Major Arcana tarot deck.

list.name: Gemini
list.effect: Certain weapons gain a functionally identical duplicate counterpart that levels up alongside them.

list.name: Twilight Requiem
list.effect: Projectiles from listed weapons summon a horizontal explosion when they expire, dealing damage proportional to Curse.

list.name: Tragic Princess
list.effect: Listed weapons gain reduced Cooldown while the player is moving.

list.name: Awake
list.effect: Grants 3 Revivals; each revival consumed afterwards also grants 1.1x Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration and Speed.

list.name: Chaos in the Dark Night
list.effect: Overall Projectile Speed oscillates between -50% and +50% on 10-second intervals, plus +1% Projectile Speed per character level.

list.name: Sarabande of Healing
list.effect: All healing is doubled, and every heal triggers an area damage pulse equal to the amount healed.

list.name: Iron Blue Will
list.effect: Listed weapons' projectiles gain up to three bounces plus the ability to pass through enemies and ignore walls.

list.name: Mad Groove
list.effect: On pickup and at every even minute after, all stage items, chests, pickups (including XP gems) and light sources are pulled to the character in a circle.

list.name: Divine Bloodline
list.effect: Listed weapons gain +5 flat damage per Armor (max +250), and all weapons gain +0.1 flat damage per missing HP.

list.name: Beginning
list.effect: The starting weapon gains +3 Amount; certain other weapons gain +1 Amount if they are not the starting weapon.

list.name: Waltz of Pearls
list.effect: Listed weapons' projectiles gain up to three bounces.

list.name: Out of Bounds
list.effect: Freezing an enemy also summons an explosion; Orologions become easier to find and Sorbettos become obtainable from normal pickup sources.

list.name: Wicked Season
list.effect: Growth, Luck, Greed and Curse are each temporarily doubled in turn, rotating every 10 seconds in that order.

list.name: Jail of Crystal
list.effect: Listed weapons' projectiles gain a 25% chance (multiplied by Luck) to freeze enemies.

list.name: Disco of Gold
list.effect: Collecting gold heals the player for the same amount (scaling with Greed); collecting Coin Bags and Rich Coin Bags triggers Gold Fever.

list.name: Slash
list.effect: Certain weapons gain the ability to critically hit, and all critical hits deal double damage.

list.name: Lost & Found Painting
list.effect: Overall Duration oscillates between -50% and +50% on 10-second intervals, plus +1% Duration per character level.

list.name: Boogaloo of Illusions
list.effect: Overall Area oscillates between -25% and +25% on 10-second intervals, plus +1% Area per character level.

list.name: Heart of Fire
list.effect: Listed weapons' projectiles explode on impact for 50% of base damage; weapons that already explode get +50% instead.

list.name: Silent Old Sanctuary
list.effect: Grants 3 Rerolls, Skips and Banishes; each empty weapon slot grants +20% Might and -8% Cooldown, up to +100% Might and -40% Cooldown.

list.name: Blood Astronomia
list.effect: Whenever Garlic, Soul Eater, Pentagram, Gorgeous Moon, Song of Mana, Mannajja, Clock Lancet, Laurel, Sonic Dash or Rapidus Fio activates, an additional Blood weapon effect also activates.

list.name: Stake to Your Heart
list.note: Numbered 0; effect text not retrieved. Included to reach the stated 22-card base set alongside I-XXI.
